header: INTERNATIONAL SEARCH REPORT Information on patent family members    International application No.  PCT/IB2021/057013

paragraphs.notes: The whole patent family annex table, transcribed as markdown pipe rows per brief section 4, one logical row per printed row, no blank lines. The four printed column heads are exactly 'Citation', 'Pub.Date', 'Family', 'Pub.Date' (abbreviated on this form; they are not the long PCT wording 'Patent document cited in search report' etc.). Only ONE citation is listed and it has three family members. The TW and GB rows print nothing in the Citation and first Pub.Date columns, because they continue the family of the US citation above them; those cells are recorded as empty rather than filled in by inference. A row of hyphens is printed between the column heads and the first data row; it is form furniture and is not reproduced as content. Every number and date was checked digit by digit at 5x magnification. All four dates are printed in DD-MM-YYYY order and are recorded exactly as printed with no reformatting; 22-01-2020 could not be MM-DD, and p22's Box C prints the same US document as '8 December 2016 (08/12/2016)', which agrees with 08-12-2016 read as DD-MM-YYYY. Cross-page observation, not a reading of this page: p22 Box C cites three documents (CN104557639A1, US20160355472A1, CN102584650A) but this annex lists a family for only US 20160355472 A1; the two CN citations have no entry here. Nothing on this page explains that, so it is recorded and not resolved.
